name: esp8266
description: Espressif ESP8266EX (Tensilica L106, 80/160 MHz, 96 KB DRAM, 64 KB IRAM, external SPI flash, WiFi): xtensa-lx106-elf GCC with ESP8266_RTOS_SDK v3.4, Renode ESP8266 models with a behavioural boot ROM

toolchain.notes: build_firmware makes bare-metal programs with the start-up and layout in the Renode tree (tools/esp8266/tests/crt0.S and esp8266.ld: code in IRAM at 0x40100000, data in DRAM, level-1 interrupts call isr(EXCCAUSE)); tools/esp8266/tests/periph.c is a register-level example. SDK applications build with the SDK's make (tools/esp8266/examples/build_examples.sh, which also writes flash.bin with bootloader, partition table and app).

image.notes: Bare-metal ELFs load directly (the PC is set to their entry). SDK applications boot like the chip: load the boot ROM ({kind: elf, path: ${RENODE_ROOT}/tools/esp8266/bootrom/esp8266_bootrom.elf}) and the 4 MB flash image with 'flash LoadBinary @flash.bin 0x0'; the ROM loads the 2nd-stage bootloader from flash offset 0, which starts the app.

renode.notes: SDK apps print on uart0 at the SDK's console baud rate (74880 by default); 'uart0 CreateFileBackend @file true', input 'uart0 WriteChar <byte>'. Pins: 'gpio PinLevel <n>', 'gpio RecordPin <n>' then 'gpio PinEdges <n>', 'gpio OnGPIO <n> true|false' drives an input, 'gpio Wire <from> <to>' makes a jumper (GPIO16 included). ADC: 'sar Voltage <V>' on TOUT (0-1 V). Bit-banged I2C: 'machine LoadPlatformDescriptionFromString "i2c: ESP8266.ESP8266_SoftI2C @ gpio { gpio: gpio; scl: 2; sda: 14 }"' then devices such as 'mpu: Sensors.MPU6050 @ i2c 0x68'. HSPI devices attach to spi1. The eFuse MAC is 5C:CF:7F:12:34:56 ('dport SetEfuse'). No WiFi radio, deep sleep, I2S DMA, or second-megabyte OTA mapping. Docs: tools/esp8266/README.md and PERIPHERALS.md.

reference.simulator: none; the models are checked with ESP8266_RTOS_SDK v3.4 examples (tools/esp8266/examples/run_examples.py, examples.txt) and tools/esp8266/tests/periph.c
